# EasyWebinar product documentation

> Official product documentation for EasyWebinar, a webinar platform for live, simulive and evergreen webinars. Each page states who it applies to, its status and when it was verified.

## Pages
- [EasyWebinar product documentation](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/easywebinar-product-docs/product-docs/index.md): How EasyWebinar works, from creating your first webinar to selling, following up and managing your team.
- [Change your dashboard language](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/easywebinar-product-docs/product-docs/account/dashboard-language/index.md): Change the EasyWebinar dashboard language from the flag button in the top bar or from My Profile, find a language by search or its own name, and check the result.
- [Change your EasyCRM language](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/easywebinar-product-docs/product-docs/account/easycrm-language/index.md): Change the EasyCRM interface language from the flag button in the header, find one of 11 languages by search or its own name, and keep EasyCRM and EasyWebinar in the same language.
- [Team members and roles](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/easywebinar-product-docs/product-docs/account/team-members/index.md): Give colleagues their own EasyWebinar login, choose Admin or User, and understand how team members differ from presenters, moderators and client workspaces.
- [AI Webinar: What AI Drafts, What It Answers During the Session, What You Still Review](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/easywebinar-product-docs/product-docs/ai/index.md): What AI for webinars does in EasyWebinar: it drafts a webinar from one prompt, simulates chat (Beta), answers attendee questions from Pro onward, and leaves you a short review list.
- [Create with AI](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/easywebinar-product-docs/product-docs/ai/create-with-ai/index.md): How EasyWebinar's Create with AI builds a webinar from a description, writing the script, registration pages, email sequence, polls and offers, and what each step costs in credits.
- [Webinar Email Sequence: Generate Six Emails With AI, Then Edit the Wording and Timing](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/easywebinar-product-docs/product-docs/ai/create-with-ai/email-sequences/index.md): A webinar email sequence takes hours to write by hand. This guide covers the six emails EasyWebinar's AI drafts from your webinar's own script, how to edit their wording and timing, when to add more and what to check before anything sends.
- [Webinar Landing Page: Generate It With AI From Your Script, Then Edit It Yourself](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/easywebinar-product-docs/product-docs/ai/create-with-ai/page-generation/index.md): AI webinar landing pages, explained: what the AI writes on your registration, thank-you and waiting pages from your script, how much you'll still change, and how to edit, check and publish them in the page builder.
- [Webinar Script Template: What Each Section Says, Then Generate a Draft With AI](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/easywebinar-product-docs/product-docs/ai/create-with-ai/script-generation/index.md): A webinar script template you can fill in, section by section, plus how to generate a slide-by-slide webinar script with AI in EasyWebinar, set its length, edit it and regenerate it.
- [Webinar CRM: Keep Contacts, Deals and Follow-Up Beside Webinars, or Keep Your Own](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/easywebinar-product-docs/product-docs/easycrm/index.md): A webinar CRM holds the people your webinars produce. This guide shows how EasyCRM imports registrants and attendees, keeps leads, clients and deals, and sends broadcasts and workflows, or how to keep the CRM you already use.
- [Email Domain Authentication: Verify a Domain or Address and Choose How You Send](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/easywebinar-product-docs/product-docs/easycrm/sending-setup/index.md): Broadcasts and workflows can't go out until sending is set up. This email domain authentication guide explains how to verify a domain or a business address in EasyCRM, choose EasyCRM Mail or your own SMTP provider and check sending health, so your first broadcast leaves under your own name.
- [Webinar Marketing Automation: Build CRM Workflows for Attendees, No-Shows and Leads](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/easywebinar-product-docs/product-docs/easycrm/workflows/index.md): Webinar marketing automation keeps follow-up running after every session. This guide shows how to create a workflow in EasyCRM, keep it in draft, publish and archive it, and when a workflow suits a group better than a broadcast.
- [Connect a CRM and map your webinar data](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/easywebinar-product-docs/product-docs/integrations/map-webinar-data/index.md): Connect one of EasyWebinar's 14 CRM and email integrations, tag contacts by what they did, and send webinar details into your CRM's own fields.
- [What Is EasyWebinar? A Webinar Platform for Live, Simulive and Evergreen Webinars](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/easywebinar-product-docs/product-docs/product-summary/index.md): A one-page overview of the EasyWebinar webinar platform: the three webinar types, the live room, selling, AI, follow-up, who it suits and its limits.
- [Limits and defaults](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/easywebinar-product-docs/product-docs/reference/limits-and-defaults/index.md): Every limit, allowance and default setting in EasyWebinar in one place, with its unit and where it applies.
- [Camera not detected: "Not able to access selected media device"](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/easywebinar-product-docs/product-docs/troubleshooting/camera-not-detected/index.md): Why the live room can't open your camera or microphone, and how to get into the green room.
- [Types of Webinars: Pick the Job You Have, Then Find the Set-Up and Steps That Fit It](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/easywebinar-product-docs/product-docs/use-cases/index.md): Types of webinars sorted by the job you want done, with the format, features and step-by-step guide that fit each one in EasyWebinar.
- [White Label Webinar Software: Run Client Funnels on Each Client's Domain and Brand](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/easywebinar-product-docs/product-docs/use-cases/client-webinar-funnels/index.md): White label webinar software lets an agency run each client's webinars in a separate workspace, on the client's own domain and without the vendor's branding, then report results from analytics and exports.
- [Sales Webinar: Choose a Format, Build the Offer and Follow Up on Your First One](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/easywebinar-product-docs/product-docs/use-cases/first-sales-webinar/index.md): A step-by-step guide to sales webinars for small business owners and solo operators: choose live or automated, build the registration page, time the offer and follow up with attendees and no-shows.
- [Paid Webinar: Run a Workshop or Seminar, From Taking Payment to Sharing the Replay](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/easywebinar-product-docs/product-docs/use-cases/paid-seminars-workshops/index.md): How to run a paid webinar as a live workshop or seminar: take payment through Stripe at registration, teach with chat, Q&A and polls, then decide who can watch the replay and for how long.
- [Coaching Webinar: How to Teach, Invite Attendees to Apply or Book, Then Follow Up](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/easywebinar-product-docs/product-docs/use-cases/sell-coaching-programs/index.md): A coaching webinar gives coaches and consultants a repeatable way to fill a programme: teach one useful idea, invite interested attendees to apply or book a call, then run the session live or on repeat and follow up by what each person did.
- [Selling online courses with webinars](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/easywebinar-product-docs/product-docs/use-cases/sell-courses/index.md): How course creators use EasyWebinar to sell a course through a webinar, live or automated, from building the webinar to following up and measuring sales.
- [Webinar Management: Run Regular Webinars as a Team With Clear Roles and Cloned Setups](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/easywebinar-product-docs/product-docs/use-cases/team-webinar-programs/index.md): Webinar management for teams that run webinars every month: give each person their own login and role, add guest presenters by link, clone a proven webinar instead of rebuilding it, and find any webinar or registrant in seconds.
- [Webinar Lead Generation: Capture Registrants, Track Their Source and Follow Up](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/easywebinar-product-docs/product-docs/use-cases/webinar-demand-generation/index.md): Webinar lead generation for B2B marketing teams: turn on UTM capture on the registration form, see which campaign sent each registrant, and follow up attendees and no-shows by what they did.
- [Webinar Follow Up Email: What to Send Attendees and No-Shows, and When to Send It](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/easywebinar-product-docs/product-docs/use-cases/webinar-follow-up-emails/index.md): Not sure what to send after a webinar ends? A webinar follow up email has to fit what each person did, so this guide gives real templates for attendees and no-shows, says when to send each one and how to schedule them per webinar, so every registrant gets the right next step.
- [Webinar Invitation: What to Write, How to Send It to Your List and What to Measure](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/easywebinar-product-docs/product-docs/use-cases/webinar-invitation-emails/index.md): Webinar invitation emails turn a contact list into registrants: this guide gives a fill-in webinar invitation template, explains what each line must do, and shows how to send it to your list and read the results.
- [Webinar Outline Template: Plan Each Section Before You Write a Single Slide](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/easywebinar-product-docs/product-docs/use-cases/webinar-outline-template/index.md): Webinar planning starts with an outline: this webinar outline template gives the sections, their order, rough timings for 45 and 60 minutes and where polls and the offer belong, then shows how to turn it into a script, polls and an offer.
- [Webinar Setup Checklist: What to Confirm, Test and Set Before You Press Go Live](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/easywebinar-product-docs/product-docs/use-cases/webinar-preparation-checklist/index.md): A webinar setup checklist for the days before and the hour before a live session: what to confirm, what to test in the green room, and what to set so nothing breaks once you go live.
- [Webinars overview](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/easywebinar-product-docs/product-docs/webinars/index.md): The three webinar types, what every webinar is made of, and how registration, the room, follow-up and analytics fit together.
- [People](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/easywebinar-product-docs/product-docs/webinars/analytics/people/index.md): The People view in EasyWebinar lists every registrant and attendee across all your webinars, with watch percentage, offer clicks and lead score, and lets you filter by behaviour or campaign and export the result.
- [Webinar analytics](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/easywebinar-product-docs/product-docs/webinars/analytics/webinar-analytics/index.md): What the Analytics tab on an EasyWebinar webinar measures, from visitors and registrations to live attendance, replay views, offer performance and revenue, and how to read each number.
- [Automated Webinar: How Recordings, Schedules and Just-in-Time Sessions Work Together](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/easywebinar-product-docs/product-docs/webinars/automated/index.md): How an automated webinar works in EasyWebinar, from the recording you choose to the simulive, scheduled, just-in-time and on-demand sessions your registrants attend.
- [Connect EasyWebinar to ChatGPT and Claude](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/easywebinar-product-docs/product-docs/webinars/automated/connect-chatgpt-and-claude/index.md): How EasyWebinar's AI connector works in ChatGPT and Claude, what you can do with it, how to connect it, which actions wait for your approval, and how to check it's working.
- [Just-in-time webinars](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/easywebinar-product-docs/product-docs/webinars/automated/just-in-time/index.md): How Just-in-time Registration works on EasyWebinar's evergreen webinars, which interval to choose, how it handles each attendee's local time, and how to test it.
- [Evergreen Webinar: Turn a Live Session Into One by Cloning It and Setting a Schedule](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/easywebinar-product-docs/product-docs/webinars/automated/live-to-evergreen/index.md): How to turn a live webinar that worked into an evergreen webinar on EasyWebinar: clone it as Evergreen, choose what to copy, pick the live recording and set a schedule.
- [Simulated Live Webinar: Run a Recording at Set Times, With Chat and Offers Beside It](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/easywebinar-product-docs/product-docs/webinars/automated/simulive/index.md): A simulated live webinar plays your recording at set times so attendees watch together while you answer them in chat. This guide covers how it runs, when to choose it over evergreen, and how to set one up in EasyWebinar.
- [Chat simulation](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/easywebinar-product-docs/product-docs/webinars/engagement/chat-simulation/index.md): Fill the chat on a simulive or evergreen webinar with a conversation generated by AI from a cast of simulated attendees, or scripted by you in a timed CSV.
- [Countdown timers](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/easywebinar-product-docs/product-docs/webinars/engagement/countdown-timers/index.md): How EasyWebinar's countdown timers work on offers and registration pages, why they matter for selling with webinars, and how to set them up honestly.
- [Live chat](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/easywebinar-product-docs/product-docs/webinars/engagement/live-chat/index.md): Choose how attendees talk in your webinar room, from EasyWebinar's built-in chat to private host-only chat, an embedded third-party chat tool on recorded webinars, or no chat with a contact box.
- [Polls](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/easywebinar-product-docs/product-docs/webinars/engagement/polls/index.md): Build polls on a webinar's CTAs tab, launch them to the room, have Create with AI write them from a goal, and see who answered in the People view.
- [Questions and answers (Q&A)](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/easywebinar-product-docs/product-docs/webinars/engagement/questions-answers/index.md): Run a question queue in your webinar separately from chat, choose whether questions are public, private to hosts and moderators, or off, and check how many went unanswered.
- [Offers](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/easywebinar-product-docs/product-docs/webinars/engagement/timed-offers/index.md): Build offer cards on a webinar's CTAs tab with a headline, a button, an optional price and countdown, push them to the room, carry them onto the replay, and measure views, clicks, purchases and revenue.
- [Clone a webinar](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/easywebinar-product-docs/product-docs/webinars/getting-started/clone-a-webinar/index.md): Copy an existing EasyWebinar webinar into a new one, choose its type and which pages, schedule, CTAs, emails and integration settings come with it, without touching the original.
- [Create and schedule a live webinar](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/easywebinar-product-docs/product-docs/webinars/getting-started/create-a-live-webinar/index.md): Create a live webinar, set a one-time or recurring schedule, choose free or paid registration and pick a registration template.
- [Create a simulive webinar](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/easywebinar-product-docs/product-docs/webinars/getting-started/create-a-simulive-webinar/index.md): Set up a simulive webinar in EasyWebinar that plays a pre-recorded video at the dates and times you schedule, with a shared chat you can answer in while it plays.
- [Create an evergreen webinar](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/easywebinar-product-docs/product-docs/webinars/getting-started/create-an-evergreen-webinar/index.md): Build an evergreen webinar in EasyWebinar that plays a recording on a continuous schedule, with just-in-time sessions, On Demand viewing and recurring daily or weekly times your registrants choose from.
- [The green room and backstage](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/easywebinar-product-docs/product-docs/webinars/live-room/green-room/index.md): How EasyWebinar's green room lets you prepare a live webinar with nothing broadcast, and how backstage holds co-presenters and moderators until you bring them on stage.
- [Run a live webinar](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/easywebinar-product-docs/product-docs/webinars/live-room/run-a-live-webinar/index.md): Enter the EasyWebinar webinar room, prepare in the green room, go live, present with chat, polls, offers and Q&A, then end the session and find your recording.
- [What Is a Live Webinar? Scheduling, the Green Room, Co-Hosts, Chat, Polls, Recording](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/easywebinar-product-docs/product-docs/webinars/live/index.md): A live webinar is a session you present in real time at a set date and time. This guide explains what happens in a live webinar room, from the green room to recording, and when a recorded format suits you better.
- [How to Record a Webinar: Check Auto Recording Is On, Go Live and Find the Recording](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/easywebinar-product-docs/product-docs/webinars/media/automatic-recording/index.md): How to record a webinar you run in EasyWebinar: check that Auto Recording is on in the live room, go live, then find the finished recording in Library under Recordings, ready to reuse as a replay or an evergreen webinar.
- [The Library](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/easywebinar-product-docs/product-docs/webinars/media/library/index.md): Find, add and manage the videos, webinar recordings, images and documents your webinars use, see which files count towards your storage, and put a library video to work in a simulive or evergreen webinar.
- [Replay pages](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/easywebinar-product-docs/product-docs/webinars/media/replay-pages/index.md): Turn on a webinar's replay page, decide how long it stays available, send viewers somewhere when it ends, choose between Webinar Replica and Custom Build, and tell a replay apart from instant replay.
- [Video hosting](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/easywebinar-product-docs/product-docs/webinars/media/video-hosting/index.md): Host a webinar video on EasyWebinar with Local import, or play one from YouTube, Vimeo, Wistia or a direct MP4 link, with the formats, size limit, storage rules and duration setting for each route.
- [Registration confirmation emails](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/easywebinar-product-docs/product-docs/webinars/notifications/confirmation-emails/index.md): The email EasyWebinar sends the moment someone registers, carrying their join link, and the Email Settings that control the sender name, reply-to address and admin copies.
- [Webinar reminder emails](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/easywebinar-product-docs/product-docs/webinars/notifications/reminder-emails/index.md): How EasyWebinar's Webinar Reminders work, how to time them relative to the session, how many to send, and how to tell from Analytics whether they are getting people to attend.
- [On Demand (instant replay)](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/easywebinar-product-docs/product-docs/webinars/on-demand/index.md): How On Demand works on EasyWebinar's evergreen webinars, letting registrants start watching straight away, how to label its button, and how it differs from the replay page.
- [Custom registration fields](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/easywebinar-product-docs/product-docs/webinars/registration/custom-fields/index.md): Add a phone field, your own custom questions, a GDPR consent checkbox and UTM campaign capture to an EasyWebinar registration form, and see where that data shows up afterwards.
- [Registration embeds](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/easywebinar-product-docs/product-docs/webinars/registration/registration-embeds/index.md): Put an EasyWebinar registration form on your own website with the Registration Widget embed code, and decide when to use the widget instead of the registration page link.
- [Registration page builder](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/easywebinar-product-docs/product-docs/webinars/registration/registration-page-builder/index.md): How EasyWebinar's drag-and-drop page builder creates and publishes a webinar's registration page, from picking a template and editing blocks to page-wide settings, AI-written pages and paid registration.
- [Sharing links](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/easywebinar-product-docs/product-docs/webinars/registration/sharing-links/index.md): The seven links in an EasyWebinar webinar's Share dialog, from the registration page link you promote to the one-click registration, attendee, co-presenter, moderator and replay links, and who each one is for.
- [Paid webinars and paid registration](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/easywebinar-product-docs/product-docs/webinars/selling/paid-webinars/index.md): Charge people to register for a webinar in EasyWebinar, take payment through Stripe, sell a live-plus-replay bundle, and track every paid registration and transaction.
- [The webinar Overview tab](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/easywebinar-product-docs/product-docs/webinars/setup/overview-tab/index.md): Use a webinar's Overview tab in EasyWebinar to read its live stats, change its schedule, manage individual sessions, set free or paid registration, add presenters and moderators, and reach its share links and room.
- [Set the webinar language for attendees](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/easywebinar-product-docs/product-docs/webinars/setup/webinar-language/index.md): Set a live webinar's Webinar Language from its Settings tab, choose from 11 languages by search or own name, and tell it apart from your dashboard language and Date Display Language.
